title: Gale Crater · Mount Sharp
subtitle: Curiosity rover field site
summary: Gale is an impact crater with Mount Sharp at its center. Curiosity landed on the crater floor, and the central mountain rises about 5.5 km above it.
whyGo: Compare exposed terrain along Mount Sharp to plan sampling across different elevations.

facts.value: Mars Express, MRO and Viking orbiters
